sentences.text_target: Tom returned home with a new treatment plan from his doctor.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm rɪˈtɜːnd həʊm wɪð ə njuː ˈtriːtmənt plæn frɒm hɪz ˈdɒktə/
sentences.text_native: Tom est rentré chez lui avec un nouveau plan de traitement prescrit par son médecin.

sentences.text_target: He placed the prescription paper on the kitchen table.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pleɪst ðə prɪˈskrɪpʃən ˈpeɪpə ɒn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Il a posé l'ordonnance sur la table de la cuisine.

sentences.text_target: The doctor explained the exact schedule for his medicine.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktə ɪkˈspleɪnd ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈʃɛdjuːl fɔː hɪz ˈmɛdɪsn/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin lui avait expliqué le calendrier exact pour la prise de ses médicaments.

sentences.text_target: Tom needed to understand every single rule on the label.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈniːdɪd tuː ˌʌndəˈstænd ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡl ruːl ɒn ðə ˈleɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Tom devait comprendre chaque consigne figurant sur l'étiquette.

sentences.text_target: He checked the correct dose and the specific interval between pills.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ʧɛkt ðə kəˈrɛkt dəʊs ænd ðə spəˈsɪfɪk ˈɪntəvəl bɪˈtwiːn pɪlz/
sentences.text_native: Il a vérifié la dose exacte et l'intervalle spécifique entre chaque comprimé.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist had already highlighted the important warnings.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːməsɪst hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈhaɪlaɪtɪd ði ɪmˈpɔːtənt ˈwɔːnɪŋz/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien avait déjà surligné les avertissements importants.

sentences.text_target: One major precaution was to avoid taking the tablets on an empty stomach.
sentences.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmeɪʤə prɪˈkɔːʃən wɒz tuː əˈvɔɪd ˈteɪkɪŋ ðə ˈtæblɪts ɒn ən ˈɛmpti ˈstʌmək/
sentences.text_native: L'une des précautions majeures était d'éviter de prendre les comprimés l'estomac vide.

sentences.text_target: Therefore, Tom prepared a light meal with some warm soup.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈðɛəfɔː, tɒm prɪˈpɛəd ə laɪt miːl wɪð sʌm wɔːm suːp/
sentences.text_native: Par conséquent, Tom s'est préparé un repas léger avec un peu de soupe chaude.

sentences.text_target: After eating, he opened the new box very carefully.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ˈiːtɪŋ, hiː ˈəʊpənd ðə njuː bɒks ˈvɛri ˈkɛəfʊli/
sentences.text_native: Après avoir mangé, il a ouvert la nouvelle boîte avec beaucoup de précaution.

sentences.text_target: He took out the small plastic bottle and read the instructions again.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tʊk aʊt ðə smɔːl ˈplæstɪk ˈbɒtl ænd riːd ðə ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz əˈɡɛn/
sentences.text_native: Il a sorti le petit flacon en plastique et a relu la notice.

sentences.text_target: The strength of each tablet was clearly written as 500 mg.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə strɛŋθ ɒv iːʧ ˈtæblɪt wɒz ˈklɪəli ˈrɪtn æz ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˌɛmˈʤiː/
sentences.text_native: Le dosage de chaque comprimé était clairement indiqué à 500 mg.

sentences.text_target: He measured the liquid syrup using the special small cap.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈmɛʒəd ðə ˈlɪkwɪd ˈsɪrəp ˈjuːzɪŋ ðə ˈspɛʃəl smɔːl kæp/
sentences.text_native: Il a mesuré le sirop à l'aide du petit bouchon doseur spécial.

sentences.text_target: The exact quantity was ten milliliters for an adult dose.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈkwɒntɪti wɒz tɛn ˈmɪlɪliːtəz fɔːr ən ˈædʌlt dəʊs/
sentences.text_native: La quantité exacte était de dix millilitres pour une dose adulte.

sentences.text_target: He swallowed the medicine quickly with a large glass of water.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈswɒləʊd ðə ˈmɛdɪsn ˈkwɪkli wɪð ə lɑːʤ ɡlɑːs ɒv ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Il a avalé le médicament rapidement avec un grand verre d'eau.

sentences.text_target: A common side effect of this drug might be mild drowsiness.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈkɒmən saɪd ɪˈfɛkt ɒv ðɪs drʌɡ maɪt biː maɪld ˈdraʊzɪnɪs/
sentences.text_native: Un effet secondaire courant de ce médicament peut être une légère somnolence.

sentences.text_target: Knowing this, Tom decided to relax quietly on the living room sofa.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈnəʊɪŋ ðɪs, tɒm dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː rɪˈlæks ˈkwaɪətli ɒn ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm ˈsəʊfə/
sentences.text_native: Sachant cela, Tom a décidé de se détendre tranquillement sur le canapé du salon.

sentences.text_target: He covered himself with a warm blanket because he felt slightly weak.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈkʌvəd hɪmˈsɛlf wɪð ə wɔːm ˈblæŋkɪt bɪˈkɒz hiː fɛlt ˈslaɪtli wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Il s'est enveloppé dans une couverture chaude car il se sentait un peu faible.

sentences.text_target: The frequency of administration was strictly every eight hours.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfriːkwənsi ɒv ədˌmɪnɪˈstreɪʃən wɒz ˈstrɪktli ˈɛvri eɪt ˈaʊəz/
sentences.text_native: La fréquence d'administration était fixée strictement à toutes les huit heures.

sentences.text_target: To maintain this routine, he set an alarm on his phone.
sentences.phonetic: /tuː meɪnˈteɪn ðɪs ruːˈtiːn, hiː sɛt ən əˈlɑːm ɒn hɪz fəʊn/
sentences.text_native: Pour respecter cette routine, il a programmé une alarme sur son téléphone.

sentences.text_target: Good medication habits help accelerate the overall recovery process.
sentences.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˌmɛdɪˈkeɪʃən ˈhæbɪts hɛlp əkˈsɛləreɪt ði ˈəʊvərɔːl rɪˈkʌvəri ˈprəʊsɛs/
sentences.text_native: De bonnes habitudes médicamenteuses aident à accélérer le processus global de guérison.

sentences.text_target: Tom noted his daily progress in a small personal notebook.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈnəʊtɪd hɪz ˈdeɪli ˈprəʊɡrəs ɪn ə smɔːl ˈpɜːsnəl ˈnəʊtbʊk/
sentences.text_native: Tom a noté ses progrès quotidiens dans un petit carnet personnel.

sentences.text_target: His severe headache started to fade away by late afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz sɪˈvɪə ˈhɛdeɪk ˈstɑːtɪd tuː feɪd əˈweɪ baɪ leɪt ˈɑːftənuːn/
sentences.text_native: Son violent mal de tête a commencé à s'atténuer en fin d'après-midi.

sentences.text_target: His temperature dropped back down to a normal healthy level.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈtɛmprɪʧə drɒpt bæk daʊn tuː ə ˈnɔːməl ˈhɛlθi ˈlɛvəl/
sentences.text_native: Sa température est redescendue à un niveau normal.

sentences.text_target: He followed every safety guideline without making any mistakes.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈfɒləʊd ˈɛvri ˈseɪfti ˈɡaɪdlaɪn wɪˈðaʊt ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈɛni mɪsˈteɪks/
sentences.text_native: Il a suivi toutes les consignes de sécurité sans commettre la moindre erreur.

sentences.text_target: The patient record showed a very positive response to the drugs.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪʃənt ˈrɛkɔːd ʃəʊd ə ˈvɛri ˈpɒzətɪv rɪˈspɒns tuː ðə drʌɡz/
sentences.text_native: Le dossier médical a montré une réponse très positive aux médicaments.

sentences.text_target: He understood why the duration of the cycle was a full week.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˌʌndəˈstʊd waɪ ðə djʊˈreɪʃən ɒv ðə ˈsaɪkl wɒz ə fʊl wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Il a compris pourquoi la durée du traitement était d'une semaine complète.

sentences.text_target: Stopping early could bring back the pain and the heavy cough.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈstɒpɪŋ ˈɜːli kʊd brɪŋ bæk ðə peɪn ænd ðə ˈhɛvi kɒf/
sentences.text_native: Arrêter trop tôt risquait de faire the return de la douleur et de la toux.

sentences.text_target: Therefore, the full completion of the treatment remained essential.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈðɛəfɔː, ðə fʊl kəmˈpliːʃən ɒv ðə ˈtriːtmənt rɪˈmeɪnd ɪˈsɛnʃəl/
sentences.text_native: Par conséquent, l'achèvement complet du traitement restait essentiel.

sentences.text_target: Tom felt much better and was ready for a good night of sleep.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm fɛlt mʌtʃ ˈbɛtə ænd wɒz ˈrɛdi fɔːr ə ɡʊd naɪt ɒv sliːp/
sentences.text_native: Tom se sentait beaucoup mieux et était prêt à passer une bonne nuit de sommeil.

sentences.text_target: His good health was finally returning thanks to careful discipline.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ɡʊd hɛlθ wɒz ˈfaɪnəli rɪˈtɜːnɪŋ θæŋks tuː ˈkɛəfʊl ˈdɪsɪplɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il retrouvait enfin la santé grâce à une discipline rigoureuse.
